## 1 · Catch up — hourly at :05
Reads the watermark and the index, fetches every message in #newpostprojects and #releaseme since the last run, and works out which rows changed. The safety net for live events Slack drops.

## 2 · Save changed rows + watermark
Upserts only the rows that changed. The watermark is on its own branch so it still advances on a quiet hour. If Write Index fails, set the state back and re-run (see read-me).

## 3 · Missed DM releases → Tara
For every OPEN project, reads the poster's Posty DM list message. A 🚀/✅ there means Slack dropped the release. Tara gets one DM per project (once), and that DM becomes the project's notify_ts, so her 🚀 on it releases the project. Slack hiccups skip the hour; they never fail the refresh.

## Workflow 1 — Index Refresh

Hourly at :05 (was nightly 02:00 until 2026-09-28).
The catch-up for any live event Slack failed to
deliver: a missed post is indexed within the hour.

Reads both channels for messages newer than the
stored watermarks, upserts into `posty_qu_index`,
advances the watermarks.

**Writes only CHANGED rows, never the whole index.**
A blind appendOrUpdate over every row would
overwrite `posted_date` with a re-announcement's
newer date — exactly what §7 step 4 forbids, since
aging must run from the FIRST announcement.

**The logic lives in `code/build-index.js`** and is
tested by `./scripts/test-nodes` (35 checks).
Edit there, re-run the tests, then paste back.
Never edit only the node.

### If Write Index fails
Write State runs on its own branch, so a failed row
write can leave the watermark advanced past
messages that were never indexed. Recovery is
cheap: set `last_newpost_ts` / `last_releaseme_ts`
in `posty_state` back to the previous values and
re-run. Every write is idempotent — re-reading a
release is a no-op, proven in test-nodes.

**Missed DM releases (2026-09-28).** The bottom row checks every OPEN project's Posty DM list message for a 🚀/✅ from its poster. One there means Slack dropped the release, so Tara gets one DM per project (once, remembered in static data). Record Alert / Write Alert Ts make that DM the project's notify_ts, so her 🚀 on the DM releases it (she is a release admin in W2). Failures here never fail the refresh (neverError).
